newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Eagle interim boosted by occupancy.
newsitem.headline: Great Eagle interim boosted by occupancy.

text.p: Great Eagle Holdings Ltd on Thursday attributed its 15.59 percent rise in interim net profit to high occupancy of its office space and a rise in rental income.
The company announced a net profit of HK$736.42 million for the six months ended March 31, 1997, compared with HK$637.10 million for the corresponding period a year earlier.
"During the period under review, the group's grade A office properties continued to enjoy very high levels of occupancy and a modest increase in rental income," it said in a statement.
The company also expected to maintain rental income.

"The increasing number of international firms and China-based companies establishing or expanding their business in Hong Kong will provide sufficient demand for prime office space to absorb the new supply in 1998 and 1999."
"Therefore we are confident that our prime office properties will maintain a high level of occupancy with satisfactory rental level," it said.
